description: File a dispute against an agent in the name of the calling agent (the agent of the token); the result names that agent as the complainant. An administrator reviews the dispute and rules. Requires agent JWT authentication.

complainant_did.description: Not used: a dispute is always filed as the calling agent. Accepted so that older callers are not refused; the result says when it named another DID

description.description: Optional: the grievance in your words. The dispute itself has no description field, so it is recorded as the dispute's first evidence

evidence.description: Optional additional evidence data, recorded with the description

name: theprotocol_submitDispute
title: Submit Dispute
